# DOMPurify 3.4.15

Unmodified ES module from the published DOMPurify npm package. Dual licensed
Apache-2.0 / MPL-2.0; see `3.4.15/LICENSE`.

Archive: https://registry.npmjs.org/dompurify/-/dompurify-3.4.15.tgz
SHA-256: `4f5d49223fa056790019d990e5e4207166a86ac13d9ec8c73d828c63d75b34b5`

Reproduce with `python scripts/vendor-file-viewers.py`. Used only in the
sandboxed HTML preview. Keep the dependency updated for security fixes; retain
the iframe sandbox, restrictive CSP and folder-scoped asset checks as separate
layers of protection.
